cost_model_summary: Work completed: built conservative 12-month cost model comparing commit levels 2 / 8 / 16 GPUs (H100-class) and A100-class equivalents. Assumptions: baseline expected consumption 100M tokens/month, peak bursts up to 600k tokens/min. Utilization scenarios: low 40%, mid 60%, high 80%. Key outputs: (1) At 8xH100-equivalent with 60% utilization, amortized compute + infra + support yields ~ $0.012 per 1k tokens; with optimizations (kv-cache, quantization, batching) can drop to ~$0.008 per 1k tokens at 80% util. (2) 16x commit lowers marginal unit cost but increases fixed commit overhead — break-even when monthly tokens > ~250M. (3) Elastic burst credits (pay-as-you-go) for spikes modeled at 20-30% premium vs reserved capacity. (4) Recommended commit: start with 8 GPUs + 2x burst pool; ramp to 16 if 3-month rolling average utilization > 70%. Model includes support uplift and private deployment networking premium. Detailed CSV shared in drive.
